* **claims:** publish the true median-of-ratios and close the rule evasions ([7d8a4db](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/7d8a4dbff165c699f68f4a16446c8f1f9c293559))

# [0.24.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.23.1...v0.24.0) (2026-11-12)


### Bug Fixes

* **inject:** render the memory block in a canonical order so re-ranking stops busting the prompt cache ([2b81069](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/2b81069f09238948385b61e4d9b8d28fa248c0f1)), closes [#162](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/162) [#388](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/388)
* **recall:** make the canonical order total and let the caveat follow the survivors ([b2ee863](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/b2ee863da51cf252c7531007d48ab4b1b47f90a7)), closes [#396](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/396)
* **status:** sum per-message receipts; session-wide means session-wide ([208a73f](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/208a73f5ed9a9841b310e20cd0cd89304f0a3586)), closes [#394](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/394)


### Features

* **status:** bill the plugin's own model calls and the session's completion tokens ([c046297](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/c0462978670639ade042fbf3d6cffb2bec29c0ea)), closes [#387](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/387) [#211](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/211)

## [0.23.1](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.23.0...v0.23.1) (2026-11-12)


### Bug Fixes

* **init:** finish the re-tag when the gate collapses or retirement rejects ([61cc019](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/61cc01971301445da1ca595e41da756ae5d97c6e)), closes [#378](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/378) [#155](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/155)
* **init:** keep the init stamp out of the memory store ([#374](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/374)) ([27e74e8](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/27e74e8fcc7ff41d092163bcf16c455706f03bf7))
* **init:** make the legacy init-stamp row inert, and make its migration report the truth ([805bc6c](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/805bc6c1781f62cf44c1dde4c37af75f6352c17b)), closes [pre-#374](https://github.com/pre-/issues/374)
* **init:** re-tag rows stored before the injection screen ([#375](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/375)) ([ab1b3ac](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/ab1b3acb5e031e97212957ca4b7b4ea1b14f9062)), closes [#372](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/372) [#372](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/372)

# [0.23.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.22.2...v0.23.0) (2026-11-12)


### Bug Fixes

* **capture:** redact attested args, and match a citation as a whole field ([15e764e](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/15e764edef56cf7b2108246c954ec0259072bb02)), closes [#384](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/384) [#132](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/132)
* **capture:** the prose extractor keeps the sign before granting code-checked ([838ac7e](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/838ac7e62b1cb580bc0eec82038db7d76a6ad3df)), closes [#399](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/399)
* **gate:** different environments are two facts, never a correction ([64184c5](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/64184c51a9f9f0fdcc7405589da49c6d7b439ffc)), closes [#400](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/400) [pre-#390](https://github.com/pre-/issues/390) [#399](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/399)
* **gate:** digits are context; only the corrected value may drop out ([d24744b](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/d24744bfd57b6171b85d4682a5709683f3a152db)), closes [#400](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/400)
* **gate:** excise the asserted value by position, not by literal ([8114cec](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/8114cecf0478cdb9e952fe64f8784e067402de42)), closes [#400](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/400)
* **gate:** same-context is established by the words, not looked up ([0d0afbe](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/0d0afbef578f20dfca094bc37da660c3e84feb86)), closes [#400](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/400) [pre-#390](https://github.com/pre-/issues/390)


### Features

* **capture:** let a failed session leave a lesson, but only an attested one ([458b8ce](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/458b8ceb092f8d8bac93920073e1bdc99dbe1564))
* **gate:** a correction retires the row it corrects in the data ([bcba2f4](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/bcba2f4f589b216eec82183a3f9700540958e19a)), closes [#390](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/390) [#393](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/393) [#208](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/208) [#389](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/389) [#393](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/393) [#393](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/393)
* **provenance:** an unverified row says so where the model reads it ([8bcb6ac](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/8bcb6ac187358581dc268fdcba29025cc51efc3b)), closes [#386](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/386)
